observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon DSLR body labeled “D3300” with an attached lens labeled “AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm” and “VR II Kit” on the box.
Photo 0 shows the lens front ring text including “VR” and “BLACK” on the box/lens packaging area.
Photo 1 shows the same Nikon D3300 body and the 18-55mm VR II kit lens on top of the box.
No photo shows the sensor size/MP, AF point count, or the stated 5fps/CMOS/DX-format details directly.

read_from: photo 0 box text (D3300 18-55 VR II Kit)
photo 1 box text (D3300 18-55 VR II Kit)

claims.evidence: Photos show “D3300” and “18-55mm VR II Kit” but do not show sensor specs/MP/CMOS/DX-format.
No photo shows shooting specs or menu/benchmark confirming 5fps.
No photo shows AF point configuration or 3D tracking setting.
Photos show “Nikon D3300” on the camera body and box (photo 0 and photo 1), not D3400.

risks.risk: Model mismatch: seller says D3400 but photos show D3300; this can change value and compatibility of accessories/expected performance.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the camera’s model text from the body and the box label (showing D3300 vs D3400) plus the camera’s “About/Model” screen in menu.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the worst-case matching what’s visible in photos (D3300 kit), not the seller’s D3400 claim.

risks.risk: Lens condition/VR functionality unknown (VR may be faulty; lens may have haze/fungus/scratches).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: zoom 18mm→55mm while pressing VR on/off (or show VR icon change) and show lens glass close-ups under light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working/unknown condition for VR and optics.

risks.risk: Camera shutter count, sensor dust, and overall functionality unknown (focus, exposure, buttons, battery/charger).
risks.proof: Ask for: (1) a live-view photo of a blank wall at high ISO to reveal dust, (2) a menu screen showing shutter count (if available) or a test shot set, (3) a quick video of autofocus tracking on a moving subject.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst-case: needs testing/possible faults until proven.

risks.risk: Kit completeness unknown (battery, charger, strap, caps, hood).
risks.proof: Ask for a laid-out photo of all included items with labels (battery, charger, both lens caps, strap, manuals).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming missing accessories are possible.

proof_requests: Send a clear menu screenshot showing the exact camera model (About/Model) and confirm D3300 vs D3400.
Send lens glass close-ups (front and rear) in bright light for fungus/haze/scratches.
Send a short VR test video (VR on/off) while zooming 18–55mm.
Send a live-view test shot of a plain wall/sky at high ISO to check sensor dust.
List and photo all included accessories (battery, charger, caps, strap, memory card if any).
response.reason: The photos clearly show a Nikon D3300 kit, contradicting the seller’s D3400 claim, and the key specs/condition that affect price (functionality, VR, shutter count, completeness) are not verifiable from the provided images alone.
